_comment: Two-pose system: idle when AI is silent, talk when AI is speaking. Pose switching is driven by audio-amplitude detection on the AI's output stream — not by AI tool calls or response events. To swap which file each pose maps to, just edit the 'file' value below.

idle.description: Default neutral standing pose with subtle head movement. Shown whenever the AI is not speaking.

talk.description: Talking gesture. Shown whenever the AI is actively producing audio.
